verdict.rationale: Close ships an official MCP server that gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar tools direct, no-code access to Close data, with a read-only `mcp.read` scope and official Claude-ecosystem support. Its REST API exposes the brief's building blocks: Leads (which double as accounts), Opportunities with `active`/won/lost status for open deals, activities, a 30-day Event Log for history, and an OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit documentation of reading email activity content via API/MCP, any documented account-brief or meeting-prep workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent assembling such a brief.
